profile.summary: Feel free to contact me at alexardenc@gmail.com or connect with me on LinkedIn!

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
• Award-winning Entrepreneur Fellowship Program with $5K startup funds for literary peer review venture 
• Lead front-end development to design a professional UI/UX and test cross-platform compatibility to meet weekly targets 
• Conducted market validation interviews resulting is 5 participants committing to beta testing workshopping trials of the site  
• Researched target market, domestic competition, and current state of publishing industry to define development goals

positions.title: Bicycle Technician - Student Worker
positions.description:
•  Train 2 employees to open and close the bike stand, make deposits, and provide customer service to  fellow students
•  Accommodate students with convenient, affordable bicycle parts and accessories
•  Promote transportation safety and bike registration on campus
•  Assist with minor repairs

company.name: The University of Texas at Austin

positions.title: IT Consultant Intern
positions.description:
•	Organized contact list for targeted email campaign resulting in improved client relationships and 2 contracts for sales team
•	Established understanding of the interrelationship between IT departments and positions by attending onsite client visits
•	Increased online following by 50% and produced daily media content for LinkedIn, Instagram, and Facebook

positions.title: Business Development Intern
positions.description:
•	Collaborated with search consultants to support candidate sourcing and screening for multinationals in China and overseas
•	Compiled reports using Excel to present weekly summary of over 1K potential candidates and activity status to CEO
•	Researched placement needs and business opportunity in China and international markets for JUSDA/Foxconn

positions.title: Manager
positions.description:
•	Balanced books by logging transactions using QuickBooks, cataloging shift reports, and depositing daily profits in company bank account to ensure all funds are processed
•	Budgeted monthly financial arrangements for equipment rental, utility, and credit card bills
•	Administered 5 employees with training and oversight to ensure daily operations ran smoothly
